C1358.title: BadgerDAO Frontend Malicious Approval Attack
C1358.summary: On December 2, 2021, malicious scripts injected into the BadgerDAO frontend induced users conducting normal transactions to grant unlimited token-spending approvals to the attacker's address. After collecting approvals for weeks, the attacker drained victim wallets, causing about $120 million in losses. The incident stemmed from compromised frontend infrastructure rather than a vulnerability in the protocol's smart contracts.

references.title: The BadgerDAO Front-End Attack: $120M Drained Through One Injected Script
